title: NSFW ~ Not a Simulator For Working: Highly Distracted
description:
HIGHLY DISTRACTED EDITIONA complete visual rebuild for a game you play with one eye on the door.

Bored at work? Got a boss who never looks over your screen… until he does?

Then this game is for you.

Meet Stefan. Twenty-two, fresh out of art school, and somehow already employed at one of the biggest design firms in the city. Dream job on paper.

He hated it by lunchtime on day one.

So he starts filling the hours with something more interesting. A little browsing between deadlines. Then a lot of browsing. Then it stops being between deadlines at all. Seven days is all it takes to find out how far a bad habit can go and what it costs when your co-workers start noticing.

• HD Edition with every pixel redrawn. Over 600 assets rebuilt from the ground up!

• Easy to pick up, hard to put down. Click, watch, and don't get caught

• Two ways to slack: a full Story Mode and an endless Simulator Mode

• Dodge a snitching co-worker and a boss with terrible timing. Get caught, and you're FIRED!

• Cash in with a pile of mini-games between distractions

• Unlock videos, software, gimmicks, story beats, and plenty more

Prefer the original? The 2016 version stays playable. Switch to it any time from the game's beta branch in your Steam library.
description_short: NSFW or Not a Simulator For Working is a casual simulator game where you try not to work anytime you can. Be careful of your snitching co-worker and strict boss. If you get caught, you will get FIRED !!!
